label: xp-ecap-defer-20261125
question: On v0.2.17 + PT0 + ECAP (#3545 port) + DEFER (#2690 port) + the M4 lab delay hooks (all env-gated, default off), does the build reproduce production bit for bit when off, and do STRATA_VERIFY_DEFER_CPU or STRATA_VERIFY_ECAP make long-context decode faster by the preregistered bar within the KL screen, before the 305-task gate?
decision_owner: the user; adopting an output-changing knob needs the user's confirmation even after every gate passes

facts.build: upgrade_gate.py prepare v0.2.17 --label v0.2.17-xp --patch v0217-ecap.patch --patch v0217-defer-cpu.patch --patch v0217-lab-delay.patch --target ecap_parity -j 4 (production online)
facts.ecap: STRATA_VERIFY_ECAP=N caps distinct experts per verify window (token 0 keeps all k picks; dropped tail entries fold onto a kept, VRAM-resident-first expert); prompt reads are not capped unless STRATA_VERIFY_ECAP_READS=1, so the KL run uses READS=1 (every position capped: a pessimistic proxy) while the replay run does not
facts.defer: STRATA_VERIFY_DEFER_CPU=1 adds CPU rows of weight below STRATA_VERIFY_DEFER_CPU_BELOW (default 0.1) one layer late; =check does the same steps and adds them back in the same layer
facts.bound: survey 2026-11-25: CPU-side cuts can save at most the GPU spin, about 1.7-2.3 ms of the 18.2 ms window; the M4 delay runs of survey-20261125 measure the slope

identity.upgrade_gate: sha256 in ADDENDUM.json (frozen before the first run)
